QUOTE: "**Which show a search field:** only `SearchScreen`. `hasSearch` defaults to `false`, and the only place it is set to `true` is `SearchScreen` (`search.tsx`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names `app/screens/home/search/search.tsx` (SearchScreen) as the only caller that sets `hasSearch={true}`, which enables the search field.
